note: EmuFusion cheat catalogue. Matched on (system, title); the title is normalised so regional and revision variants of one dump resolve to the same entry -- see CheatDatabase.normalise. Codes are passed to the core VERBATIM because only the core knows its own dialect: Game Genie for NES/SNES/GB, raw address:value for Mesen2 and Snes9x, '+' joining the lines of one multi-line cheat. A user file at files/cheats/cheats.json replaces any game here wholesale.
